purpose: S1 latency decomposition for the predeclared twenty text-only A/B cases; complete captured stages, no new inference
formula: chatTotal = decideTimeMs + answerPromptMs + generationAndChecksMs + otherChatMs; mean stages add, separate medians do not
providerFormula: provider.total_duration = load_duration + prompt_eval_duration + eval_duration + unattributed provider time
limitations: All application and relay stages include synchronous diagnostic capture overhead
wholeChatMinusProviderTotalMs is a measured residual, not isolated application overhead
Relay wall does not include all child/client delays and capture writes after response.end
No streaming/TTFT, concurrency, or production benchmark
Original simplified A has different system instructions and sometimes different token limit
